A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DEFAME and provide readable main texts, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Corresponding methods, experiments, and report examples can be matched despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, computational measurements, failure analyses, and a human evaluation.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and adds ClaimReview2024+ evaluations, a fixed-action ablation, and further error analyses.

M1.justification: The six-stage pipeline, four tools, three-iteration limit, prompt templates, and DEFAME-QA adaptation are retained. The new Static Actions variant is an experimental ablation, not a revision to the proposed method.

E1.justification: v2 adds ClaimReview2024+, evaluating 300 claims comprising 160 text-only and 140 multimodal examples. This introduces a temporal-generalization scenario intended to test claims beyond GPT-4o's knowledge cutoff. AVeriTeC, MOCHEG, and VERITE remain.

E2.justification: The MOCHEG classification comparison replaces MOCHEG with LVLM4FV. GPT-4o and GPT-4o CoT receive new AVeriTeC comparisons; their MOCHEG/VERITE participation already existed in v1's ablation table. The Challenge comparison adds UHH, SynApSE, and FactCheckFusion to the retained five systems.

E3.justification: MOCHEG's reported assessment changes from averaged F1 alongside accuracy to explicitly micro F1. New experiments introduce ClaimReview2024+'s four-class labeling and removal of veracity cues, plus a control executing each tool once. Existing benchmark sample selections, model settings, and human-study design are retained; rerunning them is not established.

E4.justification: v2 adds a planning-specific Static Actions ablation and cost comparison, temporal-generalization analysis with ClaimReview confusion matrices and the Fico case, and VERITE/AVeriTeC confusion analyses in Appendix D. v1's Static ablation is retained as Single Turn, while the existing failure cases and justification analyses remain.

E5.justification: The human evaluation retains 185 ratings over 36 claims, the 154-versus-31 allocation, and the Mann-Whitney U test with p approximately 9.1 × 10^-9. These details move to Appendix H. No new repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or uncertainty-estimation practice is reported.

E6.justification: v2 Table 3 adds ClaimReview accuracies of 67.0% for DEFAME, 34.7% for GPT-4o, and 36.6% for CoT. New Static Actions results are 58.7 MOCHEG F1 and 83.0 VERITE accuracy. GPT-CoT's cited AVeriTeC score changes from 72.4 to 65.6, and the backbone table's MOCHEG accuracy changes from 58.9 to 59.5. The headline MOCHEG F1 changes from 53.3 to micro F1 59.5, reflecting a metric replacement rather than an established same-metric gain.

T1.justification: Neither version presents theoretical propositions, proofs, or mathematical derivations. The empirical metric revision does not introduce formal theoretical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion add ClaimReview2024+ as a contribution and claim temporal generalizability and potential real-time fact-checking beyond the backbone's knowledge cutoff. The introduction also revises the claimed AVeriTeC and MOCHEG improvement margins while retaining the main end-to-end multimodal verification claim.

C2.justification: v2 adds interpretations linking retrieval to temporal generalization and fixed planning to higher costs. It revises the source-credibility and hallucination discussion and adds deployment, bias, censorship, and human-oversight boundaries in the Impact Statement. Appendix J qualifies the new benchmark by acknowledging that claims may have appeared in earlier forms.

D1.justification: Appendix J adds ClaimReview API provenance, class counts, automated/manual label normalization, and veracity-cue cleaning instructions. v2 also states that the dataset is publicly available alongside the existing code and discloses participants' educational background. Existing hardware, hyperparameters, exclusions, and prompts are largely unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds a systematic capability comparison of 20 prior systems in Table 1, substantially expanding positioning around planning, retrieval, explainability, and multimodal evidence. New cited works include Self-Checker, HISS, and M3D; several peripheral references are removed. These changes go beyond the switch to author-year citations.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and method narrative are extensively rewritten. State-of-the-art comparisons precede ablations, automatic justification evaluation and human-study details move into the appendix, and a separate Impact Statement is added. The appendix is substantially reorganized.

P2.justification: v2 redraws the introductory illustration and human-evaluation chart, adds the capability table and temporal-evaluation figures, expands confusion-matrix displays, and converts the five-system Challenge table into an eight-system bar chart. Benchmark and ablation tables are restructured, while existing report examples are relocated within a different page layout.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens validation through a temporal test set, a planning-specific control, and broader error analysis, addressing weaknesses in v1's empirical support. However, Appendix J gives the contradictory collection period November 1, 2024 to January 18, 2024 and acknowledges potentially recycled claims, weakening the prominent 'leakage-free' claim. The additions provide useful but qualified overall gains.
